transitions.prompt: One continuous real-time shot, no cuts. Begin exactly on Picture 1 and end exactly on Picture 2 in the same location. The camera moves slowly and steadily through the space with a gentle dolly, so near objects sweep past the frame edges while distant structures shift slowly, giving real depth. Keep every visible character's face, hair colour and length, eye colour, costume, accessories and left-to-right order unchanged; do not add or remove a character. Cloth, hair and foliage move gently. No digital zoom, frozen tableau, foot sliding, body or face morphing, duplicated limb, rubber architecture, teleportation, sudden speed ramp, cut, wipe, page turn, flash, text, subtitle, logo or watermark.

jobs.scrollSummary: 午前四時の思いつきから、二人の東大受験が始まった。見学、勉強、試験を越えて迎える春も、祝杯だけでは終わらない。
